name: Sylwen
title: Warden of the Wood
examine: The Evenking's heir, and the Evenguard's commander. She argued against opening the gate, lost, and now keeps the open gate better than anyone alive. Both of those are duty.
lines: Two hundred years I kept a shut gate. Keeping an open one is harder. Nobody asks the second question.
The Company cut forty lengths of silverbark. Forty lengths came back to the hem, stacked. We are patient, not gentle.
My father is right about most things. I count the ones he is wrong about. The count is not zero.
